svg.title: signoff planar reference and device marker
svg.desc: Print at 100 percent. Measure the 60 millimeter reference marker and 100 millimeter ruler. The device target center sits 100 millimeters to the right of the reference center.

g.text: Measure the black reference edge: 60 mm.
Keep both markers flat on the same plane.
Align the device marker's top edge with the reference.
This reference supports planar guidance, not safety certification.
Cut below this line. Attach the marker rigidly to the device.
Keep a white border around this marker.
